description: This Java class 'ModifyPolicyIdStrategy' handles the 'ModifyPolicyId' command within a persistence strategy for 'Thing' entities. It processes modifications to the policy ID associated with a 'Thing', generating appropriate events and responses based on whether a policy ID exists.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyIdStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class to handle modifying the policy ID of a 'Thing', generating appropriate create or modify events based on the existence of an existing policy ID.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command by either modifying an existing policy ID or creating a new one based on the current 'Thing' state.

methods.name: extractPolicyId
methods.description: Extracts the PolicyId from the given 'Thing' entity, throwing if the entity is null or doesn't contain a policy ID.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating the policy ID has been modified, creating the corresponding event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating a new policy ID has been created, creating the corresponding event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag from the previous 'Thing' entity, if any, for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag for the new 'Thing' entity based on the command's policy ID.
